mechanism_comment: Minaprine binds to serotonin type 2 receptors and to dopamine D1 and D2 type receptors. It also binds to the serotonin reuptake pump. It also acts as a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase. It has also been found to inhibit acetylcholinesterase in a reversible and competitive way.
